name: Temple of Embers
checks: every crate stands on authored floor
no rail passes within a crate
crates stand inside a flame sweep only on purpose
no hazard stands in scenery and no scenery stands on a pedestal
no crate inside a censer swing
no crate inside a patrol walk
checkpoints respawn ten metres clear of flames, nitro, patrols and swings
volatile crates keep their blast away from other boxes
platforming gaps are within a single jump and ledges within a jump's height

rooms.name: Ravine floor
rooms.lesson: carve the crate line, take the mask, read the sleeping flame, meet the crabs in the open

rooms.name: The Great Stair
rooms.lesson: hop the collapse, climb the fallen ledges, time the censer; crates on every landing

rooms.name: The sluice
rooms.lesson: drop in, pump the bends, carry speed into the crossing

rooms.name: Broken aqueduct
rooms.lesson: Ravine Break and Far Break at speed; the colonnade on foot; cross the abutment as both sentinels exhale

rooms.name: The Cistern
rooms.lesson: drop in and pump, or climb the broken cornice over the drain; time the exit under the niche sentinel

rooms.name: Sanctuary steps
rooms.lesson: four jumps up over the drain; the bristleback punishes a stomp

rooms.name: Sanctuary terrace
rooms.lesson: build speed down the centre, launch off the bank onto the dais inside the nitro ring, drop off its back, hit the green switch last
